about: Questions the team wants the 2027 logs to answer. Add yours, with the season.py command that would answer it; entry names for things not yet logged are proposals for the robot code (3061-lib). Run 'questions.py check questions2027.json ./logs' after each early practice session: 'missing' means the robot code does not log it yet.

questions.question: How far does the robot drive per match (m)?
How much energy does each subsystem use per match (J)?
How much energy does the whole robot use per match (J)?
What is each subsystem's peak power per match (W)?
How much current does the power distribution panel report per match (A x s)?
How many times does the robot brown out per match?
How low does the battery voltage get per match?
How long is each camera not sending frames while enabled?
How many pose updates does each camera contribute per match?
When did the CANivore report errors?
